title: NES game loader
description: For the app NES: send your own .nes games from a phone. "Add games from a phone" in the app shows a QR code; the phone, on the same Wi-Fi as the car (the home Wi-Fi or phone hotspot the car has joined; or the car's own, with wireless CarPlay or its hotspot), opens a page and picks the files. The page's port is open in the head unit's firewall only while that screen is up, and on a Wi-Fi the car has joined only while the app's setting for it is on; the page runs as the NES app's own user and writes only into its games folder. Also reads a USB gamepad (an Xbox pad on a cable) for the app while a game runs, when the app's setting "USB gamepad" is on. Starts when the app asks, never at boot. Restart the head unit once after installing it.
